SEC Considers Expelling LSU Amid Conference Dispute

The Southeastern Conference (SEC) is planning a meeting on December 3 to decide whether to expel Louisiana State University (LSU) as a conference member. This action follows LSU's "rebellion" which has put the future of the conference at risk. One report also mentions that RJ Luis plans to sue. The situation presents a critical juncture for the SEC, with one opinion suggesting there is no middle ground and the conference must either expel LSU or admit its powerlessness.
